description: Shared technical module, not a business domain. App-side node definition contracts read from /object_info. @comfyorg/object-info-parser owns the V1 and V2 schemas, V1-to-V2 migration, the node source classifier and pack grouping helpers, and the input spec interpreter, including flattening and searchable slot type collection. This record holds the app's interpreter binding that reports input spec diagnostics, upload input augmentation, input ordering for widget values, node help base URLs, and the essentials node list. The node definition store, node library and search UI, and widget constructors that consume these contracts belong to their own records.

characterizationScenarios.name: V1 node definitions migrate to V2 and input spec trees report diagnostics within bounds
Input specs flatten, searchable slot types are collected, and widget values follow input order

compatibilityPromises: Inventory preserves existing exports and runtime behavior. The V2 schema is public through @comfyorg/object-info-parser; cross-module imports of the remaining app files are inherited debt.
